equipment: CFP produced-water pumps, machines A / B / C
configuration: 3 machines in parallel at a common discharge pressure
compute: per machine DischP = a*q^2 + b*q + c, inverted on the DESCENDING limb: q = (-b - sqrt(b^2 - 4a(c - P))) / (2a). Total plant flow at a common discharge = sum of the three machine flows.

machine_coeffs._form: [a, b, c] for DischP = a*q^2 + b*q + c

pad_line_dp_psi._note: PROVISIONAL and measured WRONG on 2026-07-29 — all three over-stated. Prefer the measured anchor (see README). Kept only as the fallback when a pad has no live PF reading.

max_discharge_note: Piping rating. Above it the pumps shut down (Scott, 2026-07-29) — it is a hard trip, not a soft target.
pressure_window_note: Bisection bound for inverting the curve, NOT an operational limit. Its ceiling deliberately exceeds max_discharge_psi; the 2,900 trip is enforced in woffl.gui.cfp_pad_plant.CFPPlant.
trusted_band_note: The span the source spreadsheet table actually covers. Outside it these are extrapolation — machine C's fitted parabola even RISES to a 3,015 psi vertex at 22,198 BWPD and its q=0 intercept (2,151 psi) sits below the whole operating window.
machine_curve_validated_note: The coefficients were fitted to TOTAL plant behavior; no machine was validated on its own. While false, CFPPlant REFUSES 1- and 2-machine cases rather than emitting extrapolated numbers.

measured_operating_point_2026_07_29.window: 120-day means from reporting.historian.vw_mpu_measurements, plant-down days (<2,000 psi) excluded

acceptance_test: The replacement coefficients MUST pass ~86,000 BPD at ~2,790 psi — the TOTAL OF THE THREE MACHINES, not metered produced water (~112,300 BWPD, only ~77% of which passes these pumps). Today's fit passes ~95,800 there, i.e. runs ~11% HIGH.
validated_note: PROVISIONAL. Shape validated against live SCADA 2026-07-30; magnitude ~12% high with a fairly UNIFORM scale error (per machine 0.84-0.96), so a single ~0.88 factor would largely correct it. Interface is frozen — replacing the numbers is a data swap.
machine_flow_tags_note: Confirmed against Scott's SCADA screen 2026-07-30 (A 30,582 / B 23,589 / C 27,994 BPD at ~2,828 psi) and by the GPM twins x 1440/42. NOT MPU_FIC_5488/5489 — those are a different stream and produced two wrong conclusions (a two-machine plant, a 0.99 curve match).

measured_operating_point_2026_07_30.window: 120-day daily means from reporting.historian, plant-down days (<2,000 psi) excluded
